newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fountain Set sets HK$250 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Set sets HK$250 mln loan.

text.p: The following transferable loan facility was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER FOUNTAIN SET (HOLDINGS) LTD
GUARANTORS UNCONDITIONAL AND IRREVOCABLE GUARANTEES WILL BE
OBTAINED FROM 13 SUBSIDIARIES OF THE BORROWER ON A
JOINT AND SEVERAL BASIS.
AMOUNT HK$250 MLN TYPE TRANSFERABLE LOAN
MARGIN H+160BP MATURITY 5 YRS AVGE LIFE --
PUTS -- CALLS -- LAUNCHED 14.APR.97
DRAWDOWN MULTIPLE AVAIL 18 MTHS HOME CTRY HONG KONG
REPAYMENT SEVEN EQUAL SEMI-ANNUAL INSTALLMENTS AFTER TWO
YEARS' GRACE
REPLIES 02.MAY.97 GOV LAW ENGLISH
ARRANGERS PARIBAS ASIA AND STANDARD CHARTERED BANK
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
COMMITMENT FEE 37.5BP PER ANNUM
CO-ARRANGERS HK$40-50 MLN 77.5BP
